<!doctype html>
<html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"/><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover"/><meta name="theme-color" content="#141b31"/>
<title>PRU RelicDex 450 · Job 15 Unown Forms & Moves · 5 Nov 2026</title>
<style>
:root{--ink:#f3f6ff;--muted:#9ea8c0;--line:#35405a;--bg:#0d1323;--card:#1b2540;--panel:#141d33;--bright:#a99cfb;--field:#202b45}
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:15px/1.46 system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',sans-serif}button,input,select{font:inherit}button{cursor:pointer}a{color:#d7ccff}
header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:12;background:rgba(17,25,44,.97);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:10px 14px 12px;backdrop-filter:blur(14px)}.brand{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;max-width:1150px;margin:auto  auto 10px}
.logo{font-size:20px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.8px}.logo em{font-style:normal;color:#bdb0ff}.subtitle{color:var(--muted);font-size:11px}.top-count{text-align:right;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.controls{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;max-width:1150px;margin:auto}.search{flex:1 1 210px;min-width:0;border:1px solid #46506b;border-radius:12px;background:var(--field);color:white;padding:12px 13px}.search::placeholder{color:#9fa6bc}
select{background:var(--field);color:var(--ink);border:1px solid #46506b;border-radius:12px;padding:10px 7px;max-width:46%}.tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;max-width:1150px;margin:10px auto 0}.tab{border:1px solid #3d4560;color:#b5bed6;background:transparent;border-radius:20px;padding:6px 13px;font-weight:650}.tab.active{background:#7763ce;color:white;border-color:#7763ce}
main{max-width:1150px;margin:0 auto;padding:12px 12px 80px}.summary{margin:2px 3px 13px;color:#b5bed3;font-size:12px;line-height:1.35}.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}.pokemon{background:var(--card);border:1px solid #303c59;border-radius:16px;padding:12px 9px 10px;min-width:0;text-align:left;color:var(--ink);display:flex;align-items:center;flex-direction:column;position:relative;min-height:195px;box-shadow:0 4px 14px #0002}
.pokemon:active{transform:scale(.985)}.dexno{position:absolute;top:10px;left:10px;color:#a9b6d3;font-size:11px;font-weight:700}.sprite-frame{height:94px;width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:12px 0 4px}.sprite{width:94px;height:92px;max-height:92px;max-width:110px;object-fit:contain;image-rendering:pixelated;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 2px #0004)}.missing{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border:1px dashed #516181;background:#1c283e;color:#acb8d0;border-radius:15px;width:92px;height:84px;text-align:center;font-size:11px;padding:7px}
.monname{font-weight:850;font-size:15px;line-height:1.23;letter-spacing:-.2px;text-align:center;overflow-wrap:anywhere;margin-bottom:8px}.typebar{display:flex;gap:5px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap}.chip{border-radius:7px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.2px;font-weight:750;padding:3px 8px;white-space:nowrap;color:#101524;background:#b0b7cd}.tiny{color:#bdc5da;font-size:11px;margin-top:7px}.trainergrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.trainerpic{max-height:98px;max-width:100%;image-rendering:pixelated;object-fit:contain}.trainer-card .sprite-frame{height:120px}.trainer-card{min-height:205px}
.backdrop{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:#050710bd;z-index:19}.backdrop.open{display:block}.detail{position:fixed;z-index:20;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;max-height:93dvh;overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;transform:translateY(110%);transition:transform .23s ease;background:#19233c;border:1px solid #485577;border-radius:23px 23px 0 0;box-shadow:0 0 60px #0008;padding:18px 16px calc(22px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}.detail.open{transform:translateY(0)}.handle{height:4px;width:44px;background:#62718e;border-radius:10px;margin:-6px auto 14px}.detailheader{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center}.detailhero{height:128px;width:124px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:#273451;border-radius:16px;flex-shrink:0}.detailhero img{image-rendering:pixelated;width:110px;height:110px;max-height:112px;max-width:112px;object-fit:contain}.details-title h2{font-size:23px;line-height:1.14;margin:0 0 9px;letter-spacing:-.5px}.details-title small{color:#b7c1d6}.close{position:absolute;right:12px;top:12px;border-radius:24px;width:36px;height:36px;border:1px solid #475370;background:#283752;color:#fff;font-size:23px;line-height:30px}
h3{font-size:15px;margin:21px 0 9px}.stats{display:grid;gap:7px}.stat{display:grid;grid-template-columns:46px 30px minmax(0,1fr);align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:12px}.stat-num{text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;color:#d5dbf0}.bar{height:9px;background:#313c56;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden}.bar>i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:8px;background:#9f94e9}.facts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}.fact{border:1px solid #3b4865;background:#212d47;border-radius:11px;padding:10px;font-size:13px;min-width:0;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.fact small{display:block;color:#b1bdd3;font-size:11px;margin-bottom:3px}.notes{color:#b1bfd5;font-size:12px;line-height:1.45}.moves-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-top:15px;gap:12px}.moves-head button{border:1px solid #7978b3;border-radius:10px;background:#313a64;color:white;padding:7px 12px;font-weight:700}.moves{display:none;margin:10px 0 0;max-height:300px;overflow:auto}.moves.expanded{display:block}.move{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;padding:8px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid #34405d;font-size:13px}.move:nth-child(odd){background:#232f49}.move b{width:41px;flex-shrink:0;font-size:11px;color:#aab6d7}.muted{color:#9ba7c1}.about{padding:20px 8px;max-width:640px;margin:auto}.about p{color:#c0c9dd}.empty{grid-column:1/-1;color:#c2c8d7;text-align:center;padding:55px 10px}.footer{color:#8d9bb6;text-align:center;margin:28px 0 4px;font-size:11px}
@media(min-width:640px){.grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}.detail{left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,110%);max-width:625px;max-height:88dvh}.detail.open{transform:translate(-50%,0)}.pokemon{min-height:211px}.sprite-frame{height:107px}.sprite{width:108px;height:102px;max-height:102px;max-width:118px}}
@media(min-width:960px){.grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr))}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.detail{transition:none}}

.pru-doc-banner{width:100%;display:block;max-height:140px;object-fit:cover;object-position:center;border-radius:10px;margin:0 auto 12px}.pru-doc-footer{display:block;width:100%;max-width:1080px;margin:12px auto 0;border-radius:10px;opacity:.86}.pru-logo-img{display:block;max-width:180px;max-height:120px;object-fit:contain;margin:20px auto}.brand-asset-label{text-align:center;font-size:11px;color:#adb7c7;margin:10px auto}

/* PRU Job 15 verified Unown form gallery */
.unown-gallery-desc{font-size:12px;line-height:1.45;color:#bfc8dd;margin:4px 0 13px}
.unown-form-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(72px,1fr));gap:8px;margin:8px 0 15px}
.unown-form-btn{background:#24324f;color:#e5eaf7;border:1px solid #53607e;border-radius:12px;padding:7px 4px 6px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;flex-direction:column;min-height:97px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700}
.unown-form-btn:first-child{background:#382d4b;border-color:#b69be1}
.unown-form-btn.active{outline:2px solid #f1d18b;outline-offset:1px;background:#394a6c}
.unown-form-btn img{height:60px;width:60px;object-fit:contain;image-rendering:pixelated}
.unown-form-btn .form-label{display:block;white-space:nowrap}
.unown-focus{display:grid;grid-template-columns:125px minmax(0,1fr);gap:14px;padding:12px;background:#202e48;border:1px solid #5a6785;border-radius:14px}
.unown-focus-portrait{height:132px;width:125px;object-fit:contain;image-rendering:pixelated}
.unown-focus-title{margin:0 0 5px;font-weight:850;font-size:17px}
.unown-focus-meta{color:#cad1e2;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5}
.unown-form-note{font-size:12px;color:#ffdfac;margin:10px 0}
.unown-form-moves{margin-top:13px;display:block;max-height:245px;overflow:auto;border-top:1px solid #445575}
.unown-form-moves .move{padding:6px 8px}
@media(max-width:360px){.unown-focus{grid-template-columns:95px minmax(0,1fr)}.unown-focus-portrait{width:95px;height:105px}}
